  {"step":2,"file":"src/tpm2/NVMarshal.c","function":"PERSISTENT_ALL_Unmarshal","line":4794,"var":"indexOrderlyRam","code":"rc = INDEX_ORDERLY_RAM_Unmarshal(indexOrderlyRam, sizeof(indexOrderlyRam), buffer, size);","note":"The persistent-state parser delegates the NV index RAM portion to the orderly-RAM unmarshaller."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/tpm2/NVMarshal.c","function":"INDEX_ORDERLY_RAM_Unmarshal","line":4329,"var":"offset + sizeof(NV_RAM_HEADER)","code":"if (offset + sizeof(NV_RAM_HEADER) > array_size) { offset += sizeof(NV_RAM_HEADER); goto exit_size; }","note":"The loop assumes there is room for another NV_RAM_HEADER before reading the next entry."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/tpm2/NVMarshal.c","function":"INDEX_ORDERLY_RAM_Unmarshal","line":4342,"var":"offset + sizeof(NV_RAM_HEADER) + datasize","code":"if (offset + sizeof(NV_RAM_HEADER) + datasize > array_size) { offset += sizeof(NV_RAM_HEADER) + datasize; goto exit_size; }","note":"The code only checks the current entry size after reading the header fields, so a fully packed 512-byte array can still be treated as if a terminator exists."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/tpm2/NVMarshal.c","function":"INDEX_ORDERLY_RAM_Unmarshal","line":4348,"var":"array + offset + sizeof(NV_RAM_HEADER)","code":"rc = Array_Unmarshal(array + offset + sizeof(NV_RAM_HEADER), datasize, buffer, size);","note":"The parser copies attacker-controlled entry data into the fixed 512-byte orderly-RAM buffer based on the computed offset and size."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/tpm2/NVMarshal.c","function":"INDEX_ORDERLY_RAM_Unmarshal","line":4353,"var":"*nrhp","code":"*nrhp = nrh;","note":"The reconstructed header is written back into the in-memory orderly-RAM array, and if the array is exactly full there is no space left for the expected zero-sized terminator/header sentinel."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/tpm2/NVDynamic.c","function":"NvRamNext","line":345,"var":"header.size","code":"if(header.size == 0) return NULL;","note":"Later iteration logic treats a zero-sized header as the only end-of-list marker, so a missing terminator changes how the RAM list is traversed."}
]
